comment: Finally after weeks of watching the water level rise faster even for kangaroos than our local gossip on Thursdays, the council decides to pump budgetary ink until it leaks—right through the Great Sweltering Sea Monster under the council room! Shouldn’t we first raise their squeezing sirens from the sewer line if we dare to trust your "Flood Master Plan"? I still demand every municipal building have a flamingo moat or so; it worked in Melbourne the year the pigeons declared martial law!

Honestly, how lucky are “we” to have *one* decision-makers who read flood diagrams and interpret everything as *creative aquasport suggestions for teenagers that dislike pizza*! A big thank-you shout at the council for not over-commissioning those 12-tower giant aquawalks—they still haven’t figured why turtles start speaking algebra if they just hop to the basement.

Meanwhile, I'm 82% sure the city officials already plotted which part of town the mermaids will be invited back—every city is *rea...

Well this goes somewhere... If I've got it in his—like a city council reading it as though they're giving the local weather app a chance to win '2025’s Greatest Unexpectedness award." I've written this long line-up: "If we only raise rivers above Level Y1, a swarm of flying goats may crash during a moonfull ceremony" Because you ask it—then if your budget lines say “no budget… but we add goats,” you say... sure it's chaos with a pinch of un-fun!

We do appreciate how they say: 7% less sea. Let's...
